config.webhooks.disabled_desc: Enable webhooks.enabled in the configuration under Webhook Settings below.
config.webhooks.og_desc_hint: Explains to the AI when and why to use this webhook.
config.webhooks.og_desc_placeholder: Sends a notification to the #alerts Slack channel
config.webhooks.og_empty: No outgoing webhooks configured yet. Click + to add one.
config.webhooks.og_name_hint: The agent uses this exact name to trigger the webhook.
config.webhooks.og_vault_hint: URL, sensitive headers, and the custom body are stored securely in the Vault.
config.webhooks.readonly_hint: Blocks creating, editing, and deleting webhooks and tokens.
config.webhooks.not_running_desc: The webhook manager is not active, so webhooks and tokens are unavailable. Check that webhooks are enabled, save, and restart AuraGo if needed.
config.webhooks.decision_intro: Ask the optional Decisions classifier a yes/no question about each incoming event. The answer is only a hint for the agent and never replaces the security checks.
config.webhooks.decision_question_placeh: Does this event need my attention?
config.webhooks.decision_mode_hint: Hint: add the answer to the message
config.webhooks.decision_mode_gate: Gate: skip the message on a confident No
config.webhooks.decision_gate_warning: Gate mode can suppress agent messages. Only a clearly negative answer suppresses; the event is still logged and missions still run.
config.webhooks.name_help: Display name of the webhook in this list.
config.webhooks.enabled_help: Only active webhooks accept requests. A disabled webhook answers with an error.
config.webhooks.token_help: Token the sender must present. You manage tokens in the token list above.
config.webhooks.preset_help: Pre-fills format, signature and field mapping for known services such as GitHub. You can adjust everything afterwards.
config.webhooks.content_types_help: Content types the webhook accepts, separated by commas. Other requests are rejected.
config.webhooks.description_help: Short note on which service sends events to this webhook and what for.
config.webhooks.signature_header_help: Name of the header in which the sender transmits the signature. Leave empty if the service does not sign.
config.webhooks.signature_algo_help: Method used to compute the signature. It must match the sender; "plain" compares the value unchanged.
config.webhooks.signature_secret_help: Shared secret for verifying the signature. It is stored encrypted in the vault.
config.webhooks.mode_help: What happens to an incoming event: send it to the agent, only notify, or only log it.
config.webhooks.prompt_template_help: Template for the message to the agent. Mapped fields can be inserted as placeholders. Empty uses the default template.
config.webhooks.decision_enable_help: Lets the Decisions classifier answer a yes/no question about the event before delivery.
config.webhooks.decision_question_help: Yes/no question about the event (max. 500 characters). The answer serves as a hint for the agent.
config.webhooks.field_mappings_help: Maps values from the incoming content to short names: the path in the content on the left, the name under which the value appears in the template on the right.
